profile.title: Channel info
profile.description: It’s how people recognize your clips and how we tailor what the AI writes.

invalid.title: That image won’t work
invalid.description: Use a PNG, JPG or WebP.

channel.label: Channel name
channel.help: This name will be used as the watermark on your clips.

errors.invalidChars: Only unaccented letters, numbers, periods and underscores.

platforms.description: Pick all that apply. We prioritize those streams when finding moments.

country.label: Country
country.description: We tailor cultural references and hashtags to your country.

language.label: Language
language.description: For Clipealo’s menus, buttons and notifications. Applies right away; your clips’ language is set under Audience.

motion.label: Motion
motion.description: Clipealo animates as you scroll and tap. On “Reduced” you still see everything, but nothing slides or scales.

saved.title: Profile saved
saved.description: Your next clips will carry the @{channel} watermark.

zone.label: Time zone
zone.description: Your posts are scheduled and your calendar is read in this time.

audience.title: Your audience
audience.description: The AI picks moments and writes titles and hashtags with your viewers in mind.

ages.description: Select the ranges that watch you most. You’ll find them in each platform’s analytics.

language.label: Audience language
language.description: Used for titles, descriptions and hashtags. Captions are translated separately.

profanity.label: Hide profanity in captions
profanity.description: Swear words are masked with asterisks; the clip’s audio doesn’t change.

divertido.label: Fun
divertido.example: “I almost fell out of my chair”

saved.title: Audience saved
saved.description: Applies to the next videos you upload.

accounts.title: Connected platforms
accounts.cupo: your {plan} plan allows {max, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}} across all networks

disconnected.title: {network} disconnected
disconnected.description: Clips you’ve already published aren’t affected; anything scheduled on this account is left with no account until you connect it again.

connectedToast.title: {network} connected
connectedToast.description: You can now publish to {surface} from Clipealo.

accounts.planNote: Publishing to your accounts is in every plan. Scheduling needs the {plan} plan or above.
accounts.sinCupo: The {plan} plan allows {max, plural, one {# connected account} other {# connected accounts}}: disconnect one to connect another.

clips-listos.title: Clips ready
clips-listos.description: When a video finishes processing and its clips are ready to review.

errores.title: Processing errors
errores.description: If a video couldn’t be processed or has been queued too long.

publicaciones.title: Posts
publicaciones.description: When a clip goes live on your platforms or a post fails.

minutos.title: Running low on minutes
minutos.description: When you reach 80% of your monthly minutes.

resumen.title: Weekly summary
resumen.description: Every Monday: views, published clips and your top performer.

novedades.title: Clipealo news
novedades.description: New features and tips, once a month at most.

datos.title: Your data
datos.description: What you told us, what we use it for, and how to change it.
datos.precision: Accuracy of your recommendations: {nivel, select, baja {low} media {medium} alta {high} other {medium}}

resumen.title: What you told us
resumen.description: Change any answer: you’ll go back to that take with what you already picked.
resumen.vacio: You haven’t told us anything else yet. We’ll ask one question at a time, when it helps.

permisos.title: What we use your data for
permisos.description: Changes apply right away and are saved to your history.
permisos.servicio: What we need to provide the service (your account, campaigns, payments, and moderation) can’t be turned off.

estadisticas.label: Use my answers in platform statistics
estadisticas.description: Always in groups of 50 or more, and rounded.

informesSector.label: Include me in sector reports
informesSector.description: We combine your answers with those of at least 49 other people so agencies can see which niches are growing and launch more campaigns in yours. No one can see you there.

novedades.label: News and tips by email
novedades.description: One or two a month. Unsubscribe in one click.

alertas.label: Creator alerts by email
alertas.description: When a creator you follow launches a campaign. We always let you know in the app.

novedadesMarcas.label: News for brands by email
novedadesMarcas.description: Formats, case studies, and news for agencies. At most once a month.

contactoComercial.label: Have someone from the team help me with my first campaign
contactoComercial.description: We’ll reach out once to help you launch it.

historial.title: Consent history
historial.description: Every change is recorded with its date and the notice version. It’s never deleted.

conservacion.title: How long we keep each piece of data

items.tramo-declarado: The follower count you tell us
items.eventos-onboarding: How you went through the welcome

items.fecha-nacimiento: Your date of birth (the verification provider checks it on your first withdrawal)
items.ciudad-direccion-telefono: Your city, address, or phone number

borrar.title: Delete my answers
borrar.description: Clears what you told us in the welcome and afterward. Your account, country, languages, and consents stay.
borrar.confirmDescription: Your recommendations will be general again until you answer again. Your account, country, languages, and consent history won’t be deleted.

bienvenida.title: See the welcome again
bienvenida.description: Go through your takes with what you already picked and change anything you want.

sounds.label: Interface sounds
sounds.description: A tap when you press the main action and switches, and a chime when an upload finishes, a clip is published or a platform is connected.

plan.freeNote: The Trial plan is never billed and never expires. Upgrade whenever you want.
plan.perMonth: per month · billed {cycle, select, anual {yearly} other {monthly}}
plan.keepsUntil: You keep {plan} until {date}; then you move to {trial}.
plan.yearlyOffer: With yearly billing you’d pay {price} per month ({discount} off).
plan.seatNote: Each additional team member: {price} per seat per month.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel {plan}?
cancelDialog.description: You keep the plan until {date}. Then you move to {trial}: 60 minutes a month, 720p and a watermark. Your clips stay available to download for 30 days.

usage.summary: {percent} used · {available} min left until {date} · {clips, plural, one {# clip} other {# clips}} this month.
usage.note: One minute is one minute of uploaded video; clips don’t count.

gatewayToast.title: Payments aren’t connected yet
gatewayToast.description: This is where you’ll switch cards, Yape or Plin.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Amounts in US dollars before tax; IGV or VAT is itemized on each invoice.

downloadToast.title: Invoice {id}
downloadToast.description: PDF downloads will arrive with the payment gateway.
